comments.author: CilginDalgic
comments.body_html:
All Gun codes in Assort.json are preset based codes. It has the logic of working with the harmony of “_id”, “_tpl” and “_parentId” codes. One small mistake and you will destroy the entire weapon structure and encounter the problems you mentioned.

For example, you change the silencer in the code, but if you do not delete the additional equipment of the previous silencer, or in any similar situation it will be incompatible.

The main logic is as follows: Edit your weapon in the game, export the full structure of the edited weapon and add it to the assort.json file in the necessary schema.This is the safest method.

“items”: ( weapon or item structure)

“barter_scheme”: ( Prices and what currency it has)

“loyal_level_items”: (trader loyalty adjustment)

Hope this helps
